intent: Record as reviewed the rules the testlab Context enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context testlab lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A dataset file larger than MaxFileBytes is refused before anything is stored; empty and nameless files are refused too.
An upload whose leading bytes match an executable or archive signature is refused as an unsupported type, whatever its name.
A zip upload is refused when any entry would escape the archive root by traversal or an absolute path.
A Test Case holds at most MaxCriteria acceptance criteria; one more is refused as over the limit.
A Test Case holds at most MaxFilesPerTestCase live dataset files; one more is refused and the object already written is removed.
All of a Test Case's dataset files together may not exceed MaxTestCaseBytes; an upload past it is refused.
A continued snapshot's prompt may not exceed MaxPromptChars characters, counted as characters, not bytes.
A Test Case's name and prompt must be non-blank and within their limits, counted in characters so Han text is not penalised for its byte length.
A simulated user holds at most MaxSimulatedUserFacts non-blank facts totalling at most MaxSimulatedUserFactsChars characters; anything else is refused.
